instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a wide full-body shot captures an indoor motion capture studio featuring a red carpeted floor, white walls, and partition screens in the background. On the right, the man in the black cap, black polo, and blue shorts (R1) stands facing left, extending his right arm forward. On the left, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands still in profile facing right. The man (R1) touches the cheek of the woman (R2) with his right hand as they stand close together. The scene is illuminated by bright overhead lighting, casting soft shadows on the warm red carpet and neutral background.
